subject: Reseller enablement: private offer resale for CloudRise (next steps)
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cloudrise.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Reed <dana.reed@greenleaf.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0500
Subject: Private offer resale for GreenLeaf — preflight questions

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for taking the intro last week. We're ready to become a CPPO reseller for Redwood and want to confirm a few operational points before we kick off the formal paperwork:

- Is there a single CPPO template Redwood prefers for seller-facing price/term submissions?
- What artifacts do you need from us to complete the AWS side (reseller agreement, tax forms, partner listing)?
- Any recommended packaging/pricing tiers for startups vs enterprise buyers?

GreenLeaf (their procurement contact Dana copied here) is targeting a purchase in January and would like the private offer activated so they can consume via Marketplace.

I've attached a short spreadsheet with our understanding of the items we'll submit. Happy to jump on a 30-min preflight call this week.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of Partnerships, CloudRise Partners
[attachment: CloudRise_CPPO_Reqs_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Private offer resale for GreenLeaf — preflight questions

Team — looping you in. Quick thoughts below; will follow with a short checklist.

Ben: can you confirm if CPPO pricing needs a dedicated SKU mapping on our side or if we can reuse existing hosted SKUs? I think reuse is fine but we must confirm entitlement behavior.

Camila: please review CloudRise's spreadsheet — they called out three packaging tiers (dev, prod, enterprise). Any redlines for min-commit language we should avoid in the SOW?

Marcus: Marketplace ops will need the reseller's AWS Partner ID and tax docs. Can you share the internal template we send to resellers?

Rishi: if GreenLeaf is enterprise, they may request an SLA exception for latency—can you advise on how aggressive we should be when we surface latency SLOs to resellers?

I'll propose a 30-min call with CloudRise and a short enablement pack: a reseller checklist, a CPPO sample SOW, and DocuSign routing instructions.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Channel Sales, Redwood Inference

From: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Private offer resale for GreenLeaf — preflight questions

Thanks Sofia — reviewed CloudRise sheet. High-level:

- Packaging: dev/prod/enterprise looks good. Recommend we add a usage-based overage line for the prod tier (protects us while keeping lower entry price).
- SOW: avoid any absolute uptime guarantees in reseller SOWs; use SLO language and reference our SLA docs instead.
- Pricing: give CloudRise a multi-quant discount band for commitments over 12 months; we can include a short clause that ties discounts to verified monthly usage.

Attached: Redwood-Reseller-Checklist.docx and a redlined CPPO_SOW-draft.pdf with suggested language.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min preflight call (this week) — align on required docs and timelines
2) Reseller submits AWS Partner ID + tax docs
3) We prepare CPPO submission and DocuSign SOW

I've penciled in Wed 11/02 10:30am PT as an option — Sofia, Ben, Marcus, please confirm availability.

- Camila

[attachments: Redwood-Reseller-Checklist.docx, CPPO_SOW-draft.pdf]

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cloudrise.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private offer resale for GreenLeaf — preflight questions

Thanks — Wed 12/02 10:30 PT works for us (apologies — timezones got me). We'll have our Partner ID and tax docs uploaded to the shared folder before the meeting.

A few pre-meeting asks from our procurement team:
- Can Redwood accept a 60-day Net payment term for first pilots? (GreenLeaf prefers 60d)
- Any precedent for delayed invoice activation when a private offer is live but the buyer wants to wait for internal approvals?

See you on Wed.

Best,
Alex

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: alex.moreno@cloudrise.com, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Private offer resale for GreenLeaf — preflight questions

Great sync today — notes and immediate actions below. Forwarding to AWS Marketplace ops for visibility and next steps.

- CloudRise will submit Partner ID + W-9 and reseller agreement copy by EOD Mon 12/06.

- Payment terms: we can accept a 45-day Net for pilots. 60-day Net requires finance review; Marcus will own.
- DocuSign SOW: Camila to send final copy; Alex will route to GreenLeaf procurement.
- AWS Marketplace: Marcus to initiate CPPO submission once DocuSign SOW is signed and Partner ID is verified.

- Alex/CloudRise: upload AWS Partner ID and tax docs to shared drive (due 12/06)
- Marcus: confirm billing term feasibility with finance and open CPPO ticket with AWS (due 12/07)
- Ben & Rishi: prepare latency SLO language for reseller facing docs (due 12/07)

Attachments: CPPO_SOW-final.pdf, Redwood-Reseller-Checklist.docx, CloudRise_CPPO_Reqs_v1.xlsx
